topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: The words flowed from her, like autumn leaves in a whispering stream. She poured over pages, each stroke of the pen a dance, a silent communion with shadows only she saw. I found them, scattered like secrets on her desk, the edges curling with the promise of more. I watched the world she built, layer upon layer, me in it, not quite me, yet wholly formed. The air crackled with the life of what was and what could be. Night fell, and still, I sat, the papers cradled, the ink barely dry. In the quiet, her world bled into mine, and I felt the pulse of it, wild and untamed.
